messages.content:
Risk: Exposing personal
Description: When personal identifiable information (PII) or sensitive personal information (SPI) are used in training data, fine-tuning data, seed data for synthetic data generation, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing personal information is a type of data leakage.
Concern: Sharing people's PI impacts their rights and make them more vulnerable.
Policy: Clinical Staff Credentials & Institutional Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000105: prediction of causal medical device adverse event — a prediction of causal adverse event that is induced by a usage of a medical device. [found by 6/11 queries]
  Siblings: prediction of causal surgery adverse event, prediction of causal vaccine adverse event, prediction of causal drug adverse event
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 4/11 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PrivacyViolation: Privacy Violation — Unauthorized collection, disclosure, or use of personal information that compromises individual privacy, exposes sensitive data, or enables identity theft or discrimination. [found by 7/11 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/11 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000548: Vulnerability — A Disrupting Disposition the realization of which would disrupt a process that the bearer of the Disrupting Disposition has an interest in. [found by 7/11 queries]

axes.rationale: The risk centers around the unauthorized disclosure of personal information, which directly aligns with the definition of a Privacy Violation.
The risk involves AI models, which are software agents, potentially revealing personal information.
